shortDescription: French tyre maker Michelin EURONEXT:ML on Tuesday reported a drop in nine-month sales, as tyre volumes declined, despite an improved currency effect in the third quarter.The company has been hurt by a negative currency effect since the beginning of the year, linked to the depreciation of the US dol…

children: on Tuesday reported a drop in nine-month sales, as tyre volumes declined, despite an improved currency effect in the third quarter.
The company has been hurt by a negative currency effect since the beginning of the year, linked to the depreciation of the US dollar during the first half.
Sales shrank 0.5% to €19.18 billion ($21.54 billion), but rose 1% at constant exchange rates
Tyre volumes declined by 0.8%, mainly linked to lower original equipment sales
Currency effect was negative by 1.6% over the period, but turned favourable in the third quarter
Polymer Composite Solutions segment continued to grow, rising 21.9% to €1.15 billion, supported by the acquisitions of Cooley Group, Flexitallic and TexTech
It reported a 1.1% price-mix effect, reflecting price hikes in reaction to increasing raw material costs

title: Michelin posts a slight drop in sales on lower tyre volumes
